title: Procedural Cookbook: micro-actions library and incident synthesis flows
creator: Asha Patel
description: Deliver a consumable ‘Procedural Cookbook’ consisting of small, idempotent operator micro-actions ("actionlets") and a runtime for composing them into incident remediation and diagnostic flows. Purpose: make common admin tasks scriptable, observable, and safe so on-call engineers and SRE run faster, with less human error. The cookbook must support: 1) declarative manifest for actions + parameters, 2) a CLI and HTTP bridge for executing flows, 3) built-in safety validators and dry-run mode, 4) audit/tracing hooks into Console telemetry, and 5) easy composition into the existing admin-sandbox and incident-replay harness.
acceptance_criteria: Action manifest schema defined and documented in Confluence; includes inputs, outputs, preconditions, postconditions, and idempotency hint

Core library of 12 actionlets implemented (rotate-key, restart-service, clear-cache-prefix, snapshot-redis, fetch-kv-dump, reconcile-route, collect-traces, scale-pool, patch-config-atomically, grant-temporary-role, revoke-temporary-role, gather-metrics) with unit tests
CLI subcommand 'cookbook run' and HTTP endpoint /admin/v1/cookbook/execute implemented with role-based guards
Dry-run mode returns exact planned operations and cost estimates without side effects
All executions produce structured audit events emitted to Console with token-level attribution and request id
Security review complete and HSM/KMS usage documented for key rotation actionlet
Integration smoke tests in admin-sandbox and incident-replay lab pass (end-to-end)

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Actionlets performing destructive changes could be misused. Mitigation: Built-in preconditions, 2-step confirmations for P0 actions, and RBAC enforcement via Console tokens.
Risk: KMS/HSM integration increases complexity for testing. Mitigation: Provide local KMS emulator and CI matrix that runs both mocked and real integrations on nightly runs.
Risk: Telemetry overhead could add latency. Mitigation: Emit compact structured events and provide sampling controls in Console to trade fidelity for latency.
Risk: Too many bespoke actionlets fragment the ops surface. Mitigation: Maintain canonical cookbook and require feature proposal + ownership for new additions
